title: The Sleeping Queen
text: In the barrow's heart a queen lies on a stone bier, not rotted at all, her skin like milk, her lips red. Her crown is the finest thing you have ever seen. Her chest does not rise, yet under the lids her eyes move.

options.label: Take the crown from her head.

outcomes.text: She sleeps on, though her eyes move faster under the lids.

options.label: The bravest kisses her brow, as the old stories say.

outcomes.text: She smiles in her sleep and whispers a name.

options.label: Let her sleep; some dreams should not be broken.

outcomes.text: You close the door softly, but her dream slips out with you. That night the Leader sleeps it, deep and whole.
